GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

2. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   B. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.

3. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   B. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   C. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Folding as rumours only.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

6. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   B. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   C. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   D. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

10. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   C. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Rocks as rumours only.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

12. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

13. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   C. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   C. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Industry as rumours only.

16. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
